ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white surface across approximately 95% of the visible area, sharply bounded by a low-intensity black margin along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pigmentation across both lobes; a continuous black band following the trailing edge contour; localized high-contrast brownish/yellowish pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body; internal pixel angle approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire black boundary, characterized by peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex trajectory sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, irregular clusters of high-contrast textured pixels (yellow/tan/brown) at both the left and right distal tips, disrupting the black margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical low-contrast linear markings and several small, circular dark-on-white focal spots distributed across the central-left and central-right white regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive sessile barnacle colonization at the lateral tips; multiple small, circular scars (likely from prior barnacle attachment or cookiecutter shark interactions) visible on the white ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral tips exhibit significant structural thickening and color variation due to dense barnacle encrustation, altering the expected geometric point of the fluke tips.
